## Rules

- Коды string wire, enum object in constructors; no compatibility aliases or generic raw-code escape hatch. Prefix authority bound to composer owner, duplicate/foreign code/type fails boot. Registry compile once + freeze, no feature dependencies in kernel. Preserve category/path/retryable/details semantics; status remains occurrence projection consistent with registry. Unknown persisted code and unexpected Throwable yield safe registered core error, never arbitrary user string. HTTP transport changes P06.

## Guidance

dossier §3.3 fixed registry boundaries + examples §4; error-code-map site ownership. Frontier judgement chooses package exception definitions from current semantics and tests; every code has declaration/type/status/category/retryability, no unregistered cases.
